name: Roadmap
description: Features ranked by who asked, with the spec drafted from what they said: every feature with the people, companies, blockers and deals behind it (no score), now / next / later with progress from Tasks, a spec whose every line cites its quotes, and an outside page the team can turn on. Brings Deal tracker, People map, Mail and Meetings with it.
